name: Warp Glass, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level adept 2, cleric 2, druid 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like warp glass, except as noted below.

Tinted: You can choose to reduce the light level from light passing through the glass up to 2 levels.
Fogged: You can choose to fog the glass up completely, offering total concealment to any creature behind it.
Convexed: You gain the ability to warp the glass to magnify points. Glass targeted in this manner can be used as either a magnifying glass or a spyglass (chosen during the creation). Convex warping is extremely unstable, and the affected glass shatters 10 minutes after casting.
